Terroir & Cultivar

Matcha Origin & Tasting Notes

Marukyu Koyamaen

Sourced directly from the historic hills of Uji, Kyoto. Founded over 300 years ago during the Genroku era, Marukyu Koyamaen cultivates shaded Tencha with stone-ground milling yielding exceptional oceanic umami and minimal harsh astringency.

Flavour Profile Architecture
Umami & Savoury Depth 9 / 10
Bitterness & Tannic Grip 5 / 10

Body & Creaminess 8 / 10

Sarah Lin verified Sample Review
Visited Carlton • 3 days ago
star star star star star

"The mochi matcha gelato is legitimately the best in Melbourne right now. The mochi is hand-stretched while still slightly warm, while the Level 3 matcha gelato has that deep seaweed/umami kick you only get from Marukyu Koyamaen. Sit in Lincoln Square across the road with an iced latte."

Ordered: Mochi Gelato + Iced Latte • Helpful (34)
